pm-BqCt.title: Coverage: sidewalk trekker in a larger town
pm-BqCt.summary: The main town was filmed by a person walking the pavement. It has bigger buildings and more cars than the small northern town, so it feels busier.

pm-H9hF.title: Landscape: hilly grass, scattered boxy houses
pm-H9hF.summary: A slightly hilly, grassy island with boxy houses spread far apart.

pm-LYkQ.title: Houses: boxy wooden panels, vivid colours
pm-LYkQ.summary: Most houses are boxy, made of wooden panels, and often painted in bright colours.

pm-WBWG.title: Coverage: walking trail in rolling grassland
pm-WBWG.summary: In the far north, a walker on a wooden path with trees on both sides, surrounded by rolling grassland.

pm-XNt7.title: Plate: white or yellow, blue EU strip
pm-XNt7.summary: Plates can be white or yellow, short or long, always with a blue EU strip. White ones also have a blue strip on the right, like France. Front plates are sometimes missing.

pm-ZcfW.title: Coverage: only two small areas
pm-ZcfW.summary: Coverage is limited to the east of Saint-Pierre and the northern tip of Miquelon-Langlade. Anywhere else has none.

pm-iUMc.title: Coverage: walking trail in rocky terrain
pm-iUMc.summary: On the main island, a walker on a path with trees on both sides, but the landscape is rockier than in the north.

pm-o6jY.title: Coverage: French territory off Canada
pm-o6jY.summary: A small French island group south of Newfoundland. For country streaks it counts as France, so guess France if you spot it.

pm-rkZW.title: Coverage: only older Gen 3 camera
pm-rkZW.summary: Everything was shot with the older Gen 3 camera, which looks blurrier with softer colours. It is a handheld backpack camera, so no car is visible.

pm-sJ6B.title: Landscape: grassland with coast in view
pm-sJ6B.summary: Flat or rolling grassland, with the sea usually visible nearby.

pm-sUYi.title: Houses: bright timber cladding, ATV shadow
pm-sUYi.summary: In the small northern town, houses have timber cladding in bold, vivid colours. You may also see the shadow of the ATV that filmed it.

pm-ua2E.title: Coverage: boat camera between two islands
pm-ua2E.summary: Filmed from a boat between the main island and a small island. A man in a grey and black sweater is visible.
